优融Unifusion：将自回归语言模型适应: Adapting Autoregressive Language Models into
统一反向速率目标下的离散扩散Discrete Diffusion under a Unified Reverse-Rate Objective

Xiaoyi Jiang1,4  Jingyuan Li2,3,411footnotemark: 1  Yixuan Jiang1,4  Wei Liu3
 Yi Zhu1,2,4  Zuoqiang Shi1,2,4  Pipi Hu2,4
1Tsinghua University  2Beijing Institute of Mathematical Sciences and Applications
3Wuhan University  4MathonAI Equal contribution.Corresponding author.
摘要Abstract

现有方法主要将预训练的自回归（AR）语言模型应用于掩码 扩散，而我们直接使它们适应均匀噪声扩散，其中每个标记仍然可编辑 采样期间。然而，跨腐败内核调整 AR 检查点仍然具有挑战性，因为 现有的 DLM 使用不同的目标和预测参数化。我们在之间建立联系 SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S 和神经 CTMC，将其条件损失表示为单个广义 Kullback-Leibler 模型逆转率目标。我们进一步从 clean-token 中导出转换 对具体分数、后验均值和退出率/跳跃参数化的预测，产生共享的Existing methods mainly adapt pretrained autoregressive (AR) language models to masked diffusion, whereas we directly adapt them to uniform-noise diffusion, where every token remains editable during sampling. However, adapting AR checkpoints across corruption kernels remains challenging because existing DLMs use different objectives and prediction parameterizations. We establish connections among SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC by expressing their conditional losses as a single generalized Kullback–Leibler objective over model reverse rates. We further derive conversions from clean-token predictions to concrete-score, posterior-mean, and exit-rate/jump parameterizations, yielding a sharedx0x_{0}支持掩码和统一内核之间切换的接口。建立在这些联系的基础上， 我们建议interface that supports switching between mask and uniform kernels. Building on these connections, we propose优融Unifusion，一种简单的连续预训练方法，用于直接适应预训练的 GPT2 均匀噪声扩散的检查点。通过对124M和355M参数模型的系统评估， 我们表明, a simple continual pre-training approach for directly adapting pretrained GPT2 checkpoints to uniform-noise diffusion. Through systematic evaluation of 124M- and 355M-parameter models, we show that优融Unifusion稳步改善生成困惑度（GenPPL）和一元语法之间的权衡 随着采样预算从 16 步增加到 256 步，熵增加。 256级台阶，steadily improves the trade-off between generative perplexity (GenPPL) and unigram entropy as the sampling budget increases from 16 to 256 steps. At 256 steps,优融Unifusion-S 和-S and优融Unifusion-M 实现 GenPPL/熵对-M achieve GenPPL/entropy pairs of97.783/5.262697.783/5.2626和and71.516/5.666971.516/5.6669，分别；没有评价 相同规模的模型同时表现优于, respectively; no evaluated model at the same scale simultaneously outperforms优融Unifusion在这两个指标上。在这两个尺度上，on both metrics. At both scales,优融Unifusion还有 在比较的扩散模型中实现了最高的 WinoGrande、SIQA 和 BBH 精度。also achieves the highest WinoGrande, SIQA, and BBH accuracy among the compared diffusion models.

1 简介Introduction

自回归 (AR) 语言模型从左到右一次生成一个标记。这个因式分解 支持高效的训练并产生了许多可重用的检查点，但生成顺序是 固定：一旦发出令牌，后续步骤就无法修改它。离散扩散反而破坏了 完成序列并学会扭转这种腐败Autoregressive (AR) language models generate one token at a time from left to right. This factorization supports efficient training and has produced many reusable checkpoints, but the generation order is fixed: once a token is emitted, later steps cannot revise it. Discrete diffusion instead corrupts a complete sequence and learns to reverse that corruption[1, 3]。 最近的离散扩散模型缩小了与 AR 模型的质量差距. Recent discrete diffusion models have narrowed the quality gap to AR models[13, 18, 22, 14]，但是训练一个新的扩散 随机初始化的模型会丢弃已经存储在 AR 检查点中的语言知识。, but training a new diffusion model from random initialization discards the language knowledge already stored in AR checkpoints.

DiffuGPT和DiffuLLaMA复用GPT2和LLaMA权重，Dream-7B从Qwen开始DiffuGPT and DiffuLLaMA reuse GPT2 and LLaMA weights, and Dream-7B starts from Qwen[17, 7, 27]。这些转换使用吸收掩模 腐败。这种选择与 AR 训练有直接联系：吸收扩散目标 对令牌显示顺序进行平均，从左到右的 AR 解码就是这样的顺序之一. These conversions use absorbing mask corruption. This choice has a direct connection to AR training: an absorbing diffusion objective averages over token-reveal orders, and left-to-right AR decoding is one such order[25, 10, 15, 22]。然而，面具模型 只能替换仍然被屏蔽的位置。在我们的样本中，增加去噪步骤的数量 有时会降低生成困惑（GenPPL），同时也会降低一元熵并产生 重复的数字、模板或表格片段（. However, a mask model can only replace positions that remain masked. In our samples, increasing the number of denoising steps sometimes lowers generative perplexity (GenPPL) while also lowering unigram entropy and producing repeated numbers, templates, or table fragments (Section˜4.3）。统一腐败提供了 不同的目标：它用词汇项而不是特殊的掩码替换标记，因此所有位置 在整个采样过程中保持可编辑状态。悬而未决的问题是如何直接从 AR 达到这个模型 检查点，无需首先训练掩模扩散模型。). Uniform corruption offers a different target: it replaces tokens with vocabulary items rather than a special mask, so all positions remain editable throughout sampling. The open question is how to reach this model directly from an AR checkpoint, without first training a masked diffusion model.

直接转换必须指定网络预测的内容以及如何训练该预测。 现有的离散扩散方法做出了不同的选择。 SEDD 预测具体分数； MDLM 和 GIDD 预测干净令牌； M2S 预测后验均值；和神经 CTMC 一起预测退出率 具有跳跃分布A direct conversion must specify both what the network predicts and how that prediction is trained. Existing discrete diffusion methods make different choices. SEDD predicts concrete scores; MDLM and GIDD predict clean tokens; M2S predicts posterior means; and Neural CTMC predicts an exit rate together with a jump distribution[13, 18, 22, 26, 11, 12]。 因此，他们的损失有不同的公式。单独比较这些公式并不能揭示 两种方法是否学习不同的逆过程，或者仅仅用不同的方法描述相同的过程 输出。此外，具体分数、后验均值和跳跃率都包含前向腐败 内核。因此，为吸收腐败而构建的输出不能原封不动地重新用于统一 腐败。. Their losses consequently have different formulas. Comparing those formulas alone does not reveal whether two methods learn different reverse processes or merely describe the same process with different outputs. Moreover, concrete scores, posterior means, and jump rates all contain the forward corruption kernel. An output built for absorbing corruption therefore cannot be reused unchanged for uniform corruption.

我们解决反向速率空间中的训练问题（We address the training question in reverse-rate space (Section˜3.1）。对于固定的干净令牌和 噪声令牌，离散扩散模型为每个可能的反向跳跃分配一个速率。我们表明， 将每种方法的输出映射到这些速率后，SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S 和 神经 CTMC 与广义 KL 目标相同。然后我们将干净令牌预测转换为 其他三种预测格式。这种等价有一个精确的范围：转换相同的干净令牌 对四种预测格式的对数产生相同的反向率和相同的速率空间目标。 原生优化仍然可以遵循不同的路径 因为这些方法对示例的权重不同并且使用不同的批量大小。). For a fixed clean token and noised token, a discrete diffusion model assigns a rate to every possible reverse jump. We show that, after mapping each method’s output to these rates, the conditional losses of SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC are the same generalized KL objective. We then convert a clean-token prediction to the other three prediction formats. This equivalence has a precise scope: converting the same clean-token logits into the four prediction formats produces identical reverse rates and the same rate-space objective. Native optimization can still follow different paths because the methods weight examples differently and use different batch sizes.

我们通过干净令牌分发来解决内核问题We address the kernel question with the clean-token distributionxθ​(x0∣xt,t)x_{\theta}(x_{0}\mid x_{t},t) (Theorem˜3.5）。与具体的分数或跳跃率不同，该分布总是回答 同样的问题：哪个词汇标记在损坏之前占据了当前位置？一旦是 预测，已知的前向内核将其转换为吸收或均匀的反向速率 噪音。因此，它在预训练的 AR 输出和多重扩散之间形成了一个具体的接口 内核。). Unlike a concrete score or jump rate, this distribution always answers the same question: which vocabulary token occupied the current position before corruption? Once it is predicted, the known forward kernel converts it into the reverse rates for either absorbing or uniform noise. It therefore forms a concrete interface between a pretrained AR output and multiple diffusion kernels.

基于这个接口，Based on this interface,优融Unifusion直接使 GPT2 适应均匀扩散（adapts GPT2 directly to uniform diffusion (Section˜3.2）。增强现实 位置上的softmax). The AR softmax at positioni−1i-1已经预测了位置处的干净令牌already predicts the clean token at positionii;我们将这些输出移动 一个位置并使用它们来初始化扩散; we shift these outputs by one position and use them to initialize the diffusionx0x_{0}预测器。在微调过程中，我们逐渐 将因果注意力开放为双向注意力，添加时间调节，并使用线性均匀 腐败时间表。这不需要中间屏蔽检查点。predictor. During fine-tuning, we gradually open causal attention to bidirectional attention, add time conditioning, and use a linear uniform corruption schedule. This requires no intermediate masked checkpoint.

我们的实验回答了三个问题（Our experiments answer three questions (Section˜4）。首先，遵循速率等效的本机目标 来自相同 GPT2-small 初始化的不同有限预算轨迹。二、直接 AR-to-uniform 训练达到了与两阶段屏蔽路径相当的最小 GenPPL。三、跨越 五粒种子，). First, rate-equivalent native objectives follow different finite-budget trajectories from the same GPT2-small initialization. Second, direct AR-to-uniform training attains a minimum GenPPL comparable to the two-stage masked path. Third, across five seeds,优融Unifusion-S 和-S and优融Unifusion-M 随着采样预算的增长，提高 GenPPL 和一元熵。 在 256 步时，他们的 GenPPL/熵对是-M improve both GenPPL and unigram entropy as the sampling budget grows. At 256 steps, their GenPPL/entropy pairs are97.783/5.262697.783/5.2626和and71.516/5.666971.516/5.6669;在两个尺度上， 在比较的扩散模型中，它们还实现了最高的 WinoGrande、SIQA 和 BBH 精度。; at both scales, they also achieve the highest WinoGrande, SIQA, and BBH accuracy among the compared diffusion models.

我们的贡献是：Our contributions are:

  • •

    我们将 SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S 和 Neural CTMC 的条件损失统一为反向率 空间并导出从干净令牌预测到所有四个参数化的转换 (We unify the conditional losses of SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC in reverse-rate space and derive conversions from clean-token predictions to all four parameterizations (Section˜3.1).

  • •

    我们使用干净令牌We use clean-tokenx0x_{0}连接 AR 初始化和吸收/均匀的预测 内核，实现直接 AR 到均匀的适应（predictions to bridge AR initialization and absorbing/uniform kernels, enabling direct AR-to-uniform adaptation (Sections˜3.2和and4.2).

  • •

    我们将速率空间等价与有限预算优化分开，并改进 GenPPL – 熵权衡，同时保持强大的零样本精度（We separate rate-space equivalence from finite-budget optimization and improve the GenPPL–entropy trade-off while retaining strong zero-shot accuracy (Section˜4).

3 方法论Methodology

3.1 统一的反向利率定理A Unified Reverse-Rate Theorem

本小节阐述了主要理论，每个证明都推迟到This subsection states the main theory, with every proof deferred toAppendix˜A和数值 验证推迟到and numerical verification deferred toAppendix˜B。关键信息是不同离散的损失 扩散模型尽管参数化不同，但都可以通过恒等式转换为 同样的布雷格曼散度。我们首先 隔离所有后续参数化将共享的速率空间函数。. The key message is that the losses of different discrete diffusion models, despite their different parameterizations, can all be converted by identities into the same Bregman divergence. 4.3 困惑-熵前沿Perplexity–Entropy Frontier

GenPPL 和一元熵是互补的，但各自的诊断能力不足：低 GenPPL 可能 有利于重复的、高概率的文本，而高熵可能反映噪声或随机符号而不是 而不是有意义的多样性。因此，我们分析了他们朝向低 GenPPL 和高 GenPPL 的帕累托前沿。 熵。完整的评估方案和五种子统计数据报告于 附录GenPPL and unigram entropy are complementary but individually insufficient diagnostics: low GenPPL may favor repetitive, high-probability text, whereas high entropy may reflect noise or random symbols rather than meaningful diversity. 5 相关工作Related Work

基于 D3PM 的离散扩散语言模型Discrete diffusion language models build on D3PM[1]及其连续时间 马尔可夫链公式and its continuous-time Markov-chain formulation[3]。后续工作遵循两个相关方向。 第一个开发了不同的逆向过程参数化：SEDD 预测具体分数. Subsequent work follows two related directions. The first develops different reverse-process parameterizations: SEDD predicts concrete scores[13]、MDLM 和 GIDD 预测干净令牌, MDLM and GIDD predict clean tokens[18, 22, 26]，神经CTMC预测退出率和跳跃 分布, Neural CTMC predicts exit rates and jump distributions[11]，M2S 将后验均值映射到分数, and M2S maps posterior means to scores[12]。第二个 将吸收扩散与顺序无关的 AR 建模和学习的生成顺序联系起来. The second connects absorbing diffusion to order-agnostic AR modeling and learned generation orders[25, 10, 15, 6]。 DiffuGPT/DiffuLLAMA Dream-7B 使用此连接来调整预训练的 AR 检查点以吸收扩散. DiffuGPT/DiffuLLaMA and Dream-7B use this connection to adapt pretrained AR checkpoints to absorbing diffusion[7, 27].

6 结论Conclusion

我们将 SEDD、MDLM/GIDD、M2S 和 Neural CTMC 的条件损失统一为相同的广义 KL 模型反向率空间中的目标。我们进一步推导了它们之间的显式转换 参数化。使用干净令牌We unified the conditional losses of SEDD, MDLM/GIDD, M2S, and Neural CTMC as the same generalized KL objective in model reverse-rate space. We further derived explicit conversions among their parameterizations. Using the clean-tokenx0x_{0}预测，prediction,优融Unifusion将 GPT2 检查点调整为统一 扩散。在五种子 GenPPL-熵边界上，adapts GPT2 checkpoints to uniform diffusion. On the five-seed GenPPL–entropy frontier,优融Unifusion-S 减少 GenPPL-S reduces GenPPL by16.7%16.7\%相对于 DiffGPT-S 在相似的熵下，而relative to DiffGPT-S at similar entropy, while优融Unifusion-M Pareto 在 256 个步骤中占主导地位的 DiffGPT-M。零射击 下游任务，两者-M Pareto-dominates DiffGPT-M at 256 steps. On zero-shot downstream tasks, both优融Unifusion-S 和-S and优融Unifusion-M 获得最佳的 WinoGrande、SIQA 和 BBH 分数 各自尺度的扩散模型。-M achieve the best WinoGrande, SIQA, and BBH scores among diffusion models at their respective scales.

评估协议。Evaluation protocol.

对于每个模型，抽样预算为For each model, sampling budget in{16,32,64,128,256}\{16,32,64,128,256\}，以及种子, and seed in{123,456,789,2024,3407}\{123,456,789,2024,3407\}，我们在温度下绘制 (1024) 个无条件样本, we draw (1024) unconditional samples at temperature1.01.0, 与 小型模型的 (512) 个令牌和中型模型的 (1024) 个令牌的生成长度。在一颗种子中， GenPPL 通过 GPT2-large 求和移位来评估 有效非填充标记的下一个标记负对数似然，除以相应的有效标记 计数，并求幂。我们报告了五个的算术平均值和样本标准差 每个种子的 GenPPL 值。, with generation lengths of (512) tokens for small models and (1024) tokens for medium models. Within a seed, GenPPL is evaluated with GPT2-large by summing shifted next-token negative log-likelihood over valid non-padding tokens, dividing by the corresponding valid-token count, and exponentiating. We report the arithmetic mean and sample standard deviation of the five per-seed GenPPL values.

对于熵，每个保存的文本都使用 GPT2 分词器独立重新分词，无需特殊标记。 对于样本 (x)，我们计算其经验一元香农熵For entropy, each saved text is independently retokenized with the GPT2 tokenizer without special tokens. For a sample (x), we compute its empirical unigram Shannon entropy

H^​(x)=−∑v:cv​(x)>0cv​(x)Nx​log⁡cv​(x)Nx,Nx=∑vcv​(x).\widehat{H}(x)=-\sum_{v:c_{v}(x)>0}\frac{c_{v}(x)}{N_{x}}\log\frac{c_{v}(x)}{N_{x}},\qquad N_{x}=\sum_{v}c_{v}(x).

对（1024）个样本级熵进行平均以获得每个种子一个值；报告的熵是 这五个种子水平平均值的平均值和样本标准差。The (1024) sample-level entropies are averaged to obtain one value per seed; the reported entropy is the mean and sample standard deviation of these five seed-level averages.
